	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { exists = var:ucm_lifestyle_target var:ucm_lifestyle_target = { has_perk = been_there_done_that_perk } }
}

ucm_lifestyle_toggle_been_there_done_that_perk = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = { exists = var:ucm_lifestyle_target }
	effect = { var:ucm_lifestyle_target = { ucm_lifestyle_toggle_perk_effect = { PERK = been_there_done_that_perk } } }
}
